cohort: 201 pregnant women delivering while infected with COVID-19 in three regions of southern Tunisia from January 2021 to June 2022.
finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of clinical deterioration, maternal death, and neonatal intensive care unit admission in pregnant women with COVID-19.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was significantly associated with increased risk of clinical deterioration, maternal death, and  neonatal intensive care unit admission compared to vaginal birth.
